g.text: ciburn — pallets/flask · last 30 days · 2026-08-13 → 2026-09-12 · pricing model 2026
Observed: 62 runs · 148 jobs · 148 billed minutes · $1.43 list price (≈$1.43/month)
By runner: actions_linux 130 min $0.78 · actions_macos 9 min $0.56 · actions_windows 9 min $0.09
Rounding: per-job round-up to whole minutes added 100 min (68% of billed minutes)
Recoverable: per-finding estimates overlap and are not additive; the largest single one is W005 at
Where the minutes go (top job groups)
MEASURED — from this repository's own run history (7)
Job `tests` in .github/workflows/tests.yaml expands to 12 matrix legs. GitHub bills each leg
rounded up to a whole minute, so short legs pay up to 59 s of rounding each: 12 legs can bill up
to 12 extra minutes per run. Average leg 0.4 min; per-job rounding added 76 min (65% of billed)
method: billed minutes minus the minutes the same work would bill if every leg of a run shared one
job (per-job round-up removed; assumes legs run sequentially on one runner) (job data available
for 40/62 of runs in the window)
fix: Merge short legs (e.g. run several versions in one job) or prune the matrix.
.github/workflows/lock.yaml: 27 of 30 scheduled runs (90%) ran on exactly the commit the previous
method: billed minutes of scheduled runs whose head_sha equals the previous scheduled run's
fix: Skip the run when the head commit has not changed since the last scheduled run (compare `git
rev-parse HEAD` to a cached value), or lower the frequency.
Job `tests` in .github/workflows/tests.yaml sets `fail-fast: false` on a 12-leg matrix; when one
leg fails on a PR, the other legs run to completion and are billed even though the run is already
method: minutes sibling legs kept running after the first leg failed, in 4 of 9 runs (job data
available for 40/62 of runs in the window)
fix: Use `fail-fast: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}` to keep full results on main
Job `tests` in .github/workflows/tests.yaml has no `timeout-minutes`; a hung step bills up to 360
minutes per leg before GitHub cancels it. Observed p50 0.3 min, p95 0.8 min, max 0.9 min.
method: minutes billed beyond a 5-minute timeout (1.5x observed p95); 0 of 117 jobs exceeded it
(job data available for 40/62 of runs in the window)
fix: Set `timeout-minutes: 5` (1.5x the observed p95 of 0.8 min).
Job `lock` in .github/workflows/lock.yaml has no `timeout-minutes`; a hung step bills up to 360
minutes per leg before GitHub cancels it. Observed p50 0.1 min, p95 0.1 min, max 0.1 min.
method: minutes billed beyond a 5-minute timeout (1.5x observed p95); 0 of 16 jobs exceeded it
(job data available for 40/62 of runs in the window)
fix: Set `timeout-minutes: 5` (1.5x the observed p95 of 0.1 min).
Job `main` in .github/workflows/pre-commit.yaml has no `timeout-minutes`; a hung step bills up to
360 minutes per leg before GitHub cancels it. Observed p50 0.3 min, p95 0.5 min, max 0.5 min.
method: minutes billed beyond a 5-minute timeout (1.5x observed p95); 0 of 15 jobs exceeded it
(job data available for 40/62 of runs in the window)
fix: Set `timeout-minutes: 5` (1.5x the observed p95 of 0.5 min).
Job `typing` in .github/workflows/tests.yaml has no `timeout-minutes`; a hung step bills up to 360
minutes per leg before GitHub cancels it. Observed p50 0.3 min, p95 0.5 min, max 0.5 min.
method: minutes billed beyond a 5-minute timeout (1.5x observed p95); 0 of 9 jobs exceeded it (job
data available for 40/62 of runs in the window)
fix: Set `timeout-minutes: 5` (1.5x the observed p95 of 0.5 min).
ADVISORY — configuration only, no history evidence (8)
on every run and never restores a cache.
fix: Set `cache: pip` on `actions/setup-python`, or cache `~/.cache/pip` with `actions/cache`.
Job `build` in .github/workflows/publish.yaml has no `timeout-minutes`; a hung step bills up to
360 minutes per leg before GitHub cancels it.
fix: Set `timeout-minutes` to roughly 1.5x the job's p95 runtime.
Job `create-release` in .github/workflows/publish.yaml has no `timeout-minutes`; a hung step bills
up to 360 minutes per leg before GitHub cancels it.
fix: Set `timeout-minutes` to roughly 1.5x the job's p95 runtime.
Job `publish-pypi` in .github/workflows/publish.yaml has no `timeout-minutes`; a hung step bills
up to 360 minutes per leg before GitHub cancels it.
fix: Set `timeout-minutes` to roughly 1.5x the job's p95 runtime.
Job `zizmor` in .github/workflows/zizmor.yaml has no `timeout-minutes`; a hung step bills up to
360 minutes per leg before GitHub cancels it.
fix: Set `timeout-minutes` to roughly 1.5x the job's p95 runtime.
.github/workflows/pre-commit.yaml runs on push, pull_request for every change, but this repository
has separable trees (docs/**, **.md); changes that only touch them still pay for a full run.
fix: Add `paths-ignore` for documentation-only trees (or `paths` for the code).
Job `zizmor` in .github/workflows/zizmor.yaml runs on `ubuntu-latest` (2-core, list price
$0.006/min) but every step is lightweight (linting, labelling, scripting). `ubuntu-slim` (1 vCPU,
$0.002/min, 15-minute job limit) is built for this.
fix: Switch `runs-on` to `ubuntu-slim` if the job stays well under 15 minutes.
Job `build` in .github/workflows/publish.yaml uploads `dist/` as an artifact with the default
retention (up to 90 days); broad paths accrue storage charges long after the run is forgotten.
fix: Narrow `path` to what is needed and set `retention-days` (e.g. 7).
